content.short: Current is a US mobile banking app with spending and savings accounts, a debit card and teen accounts.
content.description: Current is a US consumer fintech that offers mobile-first banking to everyday Americans and, notably, to teenagers through parent-managed accounts. Working with partner banks, it provides spending accounts, a debit card, savings pods with boosted rates, fee-free overdraft, faster direct deposit and money-management tools built for younger and underbanked users. Current has also offered crypto access and points-based rewards, but its core is simple, low-fee everyday banking rather than an on-chain wallet. By focusing on accessible accounts, teen banking and financial-wellness features, it competes with other US neobanks for people who want an alternative to traditional banks.
